policy.headline: the disagreement between the two independent estimators
policy.hca: pinned to the measured home-win rate of the official completed-game log; never a free fit coefficient
policy.luck: z-score per team vs walk-forward win probabilities; |z|>2 refuses the bet surface
policy.totals: possessions x points-per-possession (estimator B) beside the ridge total (A)
policy.parlays: measured rho printed with every correlated price; naive product printed beside it
policy.market_prior: blank unless a closing-line feed is connected; weight formula printed in data/app/closing_lines.json

hca_measurement.formula: hca = Phi^-1(home-win rate) * SD(margin) over the official log

estimator_a.name: ridge margin model (Massey-style), HCA pinned
estimator_a.oos_sample: expanding walk-forward over the official completed-game log (games 1-45 warm-up; each later game predicted from games before it)

estimator_b.name: possession efficiency (possessions x PPP) from the three official pages
estimator_b.label: IN-SAMPLE against the 2026-11-15 stat snapshot (no historical snapshots are stored) — flagged, not presented as out-of-sample

blend.note: the blend is published underneath the disagreement, never as the headline

rho_note: correlation of the ridge model's margin and total residuals over the 214-game official log; used for every same-game parlay price

market_anchored_prior.formula: blended = w * model + (1 - w) * closing, w = exp(-logloss_model) / (exp(-logloss_model) + exp(-logloss_closing)), log losses measured out-of-sample
